title: Seeing through Denoising: Frequency-guided One-step Denoising for Infrared Small Target Detection
title_zh: 透过去噪看本质：面向红外小目标检测的频率引导单步去噪

paragraphs.en: 提出DiffIRSTD生成式框架，将红外小目标检测转化为频率引导的单步背景重建问题。 Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task due to the extremely small size of targets, low signal-to-noise ratios, and heavy background clutter in infrared imagery. While the progress of deep learning has advanced this field, existing methods primarily adopt discriminative paradigms that directly map images to target masks, overlooking the potential of generative modeling. In this paper, we propose DiffIRSTD, a novel generative framework that reformulates infrared small target detection as a background reconstruction problem. Instead of explicitly predicting target regions, we reinterpret small targets as noise-like signals and leverage a diffusion-based model to recover a clean, target-free background from a perturbed input image. The residual between the reconstructed background and the original image is then exploited to highlight candidate target regions, providing explicit cues for subsequent detection. To address the computational cost typically associated with diffusion sampling, we introduce a one-step denoising strategy that enables efficient background reconstruction while maintaining practical inference speed. Furthermore, we present a frequency-guided perception loss to preserve high-frequency background details and focus more on the reconstruction quality of target regions. More importantly, our DiffIRSTD operates as a plug-and-play framework, compatible with existing IRSTD models without increasing the computational complexity of detectors. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 提出DiffIRSTD生成式框架，将红外小目标检测转化为频率引导的单步背景重建问题。由于目标尺寸极小、信噪比低以及红外图像中背景杂波严重，红外小目标检测（IRSTD）是一项具有挑战性的任务。 尽管深度学习的进展推动了该领域的发展，但现有方法主要采用直接将图像映射到目标掩码的判别式范式，忽视了生成式建模的潜力。 在本文中，我们提出DiffIRSTD，这是一种新颖的生成式框架，将红外小目标检测重新表述为背景重建问题。 我们不显式地预测目标区域，而是将小目标重新解释为类噪声信号，并利用基于扩散的模型从受扰动的输入图像中恢复干净的无目标背景。 然后利用重建背景与原始图像之间的残差来突出候选目标区域，为后续检测提供显式线索。 为解决通常与扩散采样相关的计算成本问题，我们引入了一种单步去噪策略，在保持实际推理速度的同时实现高效的背景重建。 此外，我们提出了一种频率引导的感知损失，以保留高频背景细节，并更加关注目标区域的重建质量。 更重要的是，我们的DiffIRSTD作为一个即插即用框架运行，与现有IRSTD模型兼容，且不会增加检测器的计算复杂度。 在IRSTD-1K、NUAA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST数据集上的大量实验证明了我们方法的优越性，在三个基准上均取得了最先进的性能。
